targets.rawSql: select date_day::timestamp as time, gross_revenue_usd, refund_amount_usd, net_revenue_usd from analytics_platinum.mart_finance_daily where $__timeFilter(date_day) order by 1

select session_date::timestamp as time, sum(converted_sessions)::numeric / nullif(sum(sessions), 0) as conversion_rate from analytics_platinum.mart_marketing_daily where $__timeFilter(session_date) group by session_date order by 1

select session_date::timestamp as time, sum(sessions) as sessions, sum(reached_products) as products, sum(reached_cart) as cart, sum(reached_thank_you) as thank_you from analytics_platinum.mart_funnel_daily where $__timeFilter(session_date) group by session_date order by 1
